blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) typically exhibit a performance profile where reliability degrades as task complexity increases. We address the challenge of generating high-quality natural language executable plans for complex tasks by introducing GRASP , a strategy-aware, multi-stage planning framework. GRASP decouples the planning pipeline across specialized, context-isolated modules: it pre-compiles global macro-guidelines ( GenPlan ), explores alternative localized strategies within isolated context windows ( RevPlan ), and independently evaluates trajectories using a multi-criteria discriminator ( VerPlan ). Empirical evaluations show that GRASP consistently establishes a new state-of-the-art frontier across diverse datasets, yielding substantial accuracy gains over direct LLM planners on Natural Plan Calendar Scheduling ( ∼ \sim 12.4% ↑ \uparrow ), ZebraLogic ( ∼ \sim 30.8% ↑ \uparrow ), and SciBench Math. Crucially, under multi-task scaling—where standard planners suffer immediate performance collapse—GRASP completely flattens the multi-task degradation penalty. In interleaved dual-task environments, GRASP achieves an absolute accuracy gain of up to 16.7% over direct LLM planners. Furthermore, by isolating context and enforcing strict macro-regularization, GRASP outperforms frontier reasoning models (such as GPT-5-mini) by a margin of 14.5%.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)通常表现出性能特征,随着任务复杂性的增加,可靠性下降. 我们通过采用具有战略意识的多阶段规划框架 -- -- 巨猿生存方案 -- -- 来应对为复杂任务制定高质量的自然语言可执行计划的挑战。 GRASP将规划管道脱钩,跨越专业的,上下文隔离的模块:它预编全球宏观指南(Gen Plan ),在孤立的上下文窗口(Rev Plan )内探索其他本地化战略(Rev Plan ),并使用多标准歧视者(Ver Plan )独立评价轨迹. 经验评价显示,巨猿生存方案在各种数据集之间一贯建立了最新的前沿,在自然计划日历日程安排方面,与直接的 LLM 规划人员相比,在自然计划日程安排方面(\\sim 12.4% \ o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o ) 、 ZebraLogic(\sim 30.8% o o o o o o o o o o o o ro) 和 Sci Bench Math 方面, 取得了相当的准确性收益。 至关重要的是,在多任务规模下——在标准规划人员立即出现性能崩溃的情况下——巨猿生存方案将多任务降解处罚完全平息。 在互换的双任务环境中,巨猿生存方案比直接的LLM规划者实现16.7%的绝对精度增益. 此外,巨猿生存方案通过孤立环境和实行严格的宏观规范,使前沿推理模型(如GPT-5-mini)的效率超过14.5%。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have emerged as a prominent paradigm for automating complex, multi-step workflows across diverse enterprise domains Wang and others (2025a) . Unlike traditional deterministic software, LLM-based agents can dynamically interpret open-vocabulary natural language specifications ( tasks ) and adapt to real-time context shifts ( task instances ) without explicit reprogramming Wooldridge and Jennings (1995) . However, directly steering an LLM using layered, long-horizon natural language instructions presents severe architectural challenges. As task complexity (as defined in Dziri et al. (2023) ) scales, models experience a sharp performance degradation, often termed the “Curse of Instructions” Harada et al. (2025) , where constraint collisions and attention fatigue trigger hallucinations and multi-step execution failures Wei et al. (2022) ; Yao et al. (2023) . This vulnerability highlights the need for explicit plan generation that transforms high-level descriptions into structured, decomposed execution paths.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)代理商作为跨不同企业领域Wang等(2025a)实现复杂多步骤工作流程自动化的突出范例出现. 与传统定型软件不同的是,基于LLM的代理可以动态地解释开放-vobulary自然语言规格(任务),并适应实时上下文变化(任务例),而无需明确重新编程Wooldridge和Jennings(1995年). 然而,使用分层的长视距自然语言指示直接引导LLM,对建筑构成严重挑战. 作为任务的复杂性(如Dziri等人(2023年)所定义的)尺度,模型发生剧烈性能退化,常被称为"指令的诅咒"(Harada等人(2025年),其中约束碰撞和注意力疲劳引发幻觉和多步执行失败的Wei等人(2022年);姚等人(2023年). 这种脆弱性突出表明,需要制定明确的计划,将高层描述转化为结构化、分解化的执行路径。

blocks.en: Effective plan generation mitigates this scaling penalty by dividing an intricate task into ordered sub-steps whose individual complexity falls within the model’s reliable operating range. In this paper, we propose GRASP , an autonomous framework for asynchronous plan generation in agentic AI systems. Inspired by human cognitive processes—namely identification, reasoning, and judgment—GRASP decouples the planning pipeline into specialized, context-isolated modules. The architecture first compiles global hard constraints and soft guidelines ( GenPlan ), explores localized strategic paths across separate context windows ( RevPlan ), and independently evaluates trajectories using a multi-criteria discriminator ( VerPlan ). This strict contextual separation prevents cross-contamination and breaks the compounding error cascades that degrade single-track planners.
blocks.zh: 制定有效的计划可以减轻这种规模效应,办法是将一项复杂的任务分成命令的子步骤,这些子步骤的个人复杂性属于模型可靠的操作范围。 在本文中,我们提出巨猿生存方案,这是一个在代理AI系统中同步计划生成的自主框架。 受人类认知过程——即识别、推理和判断——的启发,巨猿生存方案将规划管道分离成专门的、与背景隔离的模块。 该架构首先汇编了全球硬约束和软指导方针(GenPlan ),探索跨越不同上下文窗口的本地化战略路径(RevPlan ),并使用多标准歧视者(VerPlan )独立评价轨迹. 这种严格的内在分离可以防止交叉污染,并打破使单轨规划人员退化的复合误差级联.

blocks.en: Finally, robust execution is paramount to translating high-quality plans into correct downstream results. Attempting to execute a multi-step plan within a single monolithic LLM track collapses the structural benefits of decomposition and exacerbates context pollution. To address this, we interface GRASP with RunAgent Srivastava et al. (2026) , a multi-agent plan execution platform.
blocks.zh: 最后,强有力的执行对于将高质量的计划转化为正确的下游结果至关重要。 试图在一个单一的LLM轨道内执行一个多步骤计划,使分解的结构性好处崩溃,加剧了环境污染。 为了解决这个问题,我们将GRASP与RunAgent Srivastava等人(2026年)接口,后者是一个多代理计划执行平台.

blocks.en: In summary, the primary contributions of this work are three-fold: (1) We introduce GRASP, an autonomous, multi-stage planning framework that enforces global macro-regularization and context-isolated strategic refinement to eliminate compounding error feedback loops in LLM planning. (2) We demonstrate the critical interdependence of modular planning components through a comprehensive ablation study, revealing how local search optimization collapses into unconstrained hallucination loops without global macro guardrails. (3) Through extensive empirical evaluations spanning programmatic execution and pure LLM execution, we demonstrate that GRASP establishes a new state-of-the-art frontier. Strikingly, under multi-task scaling, GRASP completely neutralizes the contextual degradation penalties that plague standard language architectures. In interleaved dual-task environments, GRASP enabled by standard language backbones achieves an absolute accuracy gain of up to 16.7 % 16.7\% over direct baselines, systematically outpacing premium, native frontier reasoning models such as GPT-5-mini by 14.5 % 14.5\% .
blocks.zh: 总之,这项工作的主要贡献有三: (1)我们推行巨猿生存方案,这是一个自主的,多阶段的规划框架,它执行全球宏观规范化和上下文化的战略改进,以消除LLM规划中复杂的错误反馈循环. (2)我们通过全面消减研究,展示模块化规划各组成部分的关键相互依存性,揭示本地搜索优化如何在无全球宏观护栏的情况下崩溃为不受约束的幻觉循环. (3) 通过涵盖方案执行和纯LLM执行的广泛的经验性评价,我们表明,巨猿生存方案建立了一个最新领域。 令人惊叹的是,在多任务规模下,巨猿生存方案完全消除了困扰标准语言结构的背景退化处罚。 在互换双任务环境中,由标准语言主干线所启用的巨猿生存方案在直接基线上实现了16.7%的绝对准确性增益,系统性地超过了溢价,GPT-5-mini等本土边疆推理模型比14.5%的14.5+%.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Autonomous Agents Computing agents originated in 1970s rule-based expert systems like DENDRAL and MYCIN Buchanan et al. (1969) ; Shortliffe (1974) , later evolving through decision theory and cognitive architectures into autonomous systems Pearl (1988) ; Newell (1990) ; Kaelbling et al. (1998) . Modern language model (LLM) agents act as task-directed workflows that perceive, plan, and execute within complex environments Wang and others (2025a) ; Wang and others (2025b) ; Mohammadi et al. (2025) . Rather than acting as rigid programmatic scripts, effective agents must exhibit human-like adaptability to handle complex multi-step routines autonomously under dynamic context shifts.
blocks.zh: 自主代理计算剂起源于1970年代的基于规则的专家系统,如DENDRAL和MYCIN Buchanan等人(1969年);Shortliffe(1974年),后来通过决策理论和认知架构演变为自主系统Pearl(1988年);Newell(1990年);Kaelbling等人(1998年)。 现代语言模型(LLM)代理作为任务导向的工作流程,在复杂环境下感知,计划,执行 王等人(2025a); 王等人(2025b); 穆罕默德等人(2025). 有效的代理商不应充当僵化的程序脚本,而必须表现出像人一样的适应性,以便在动态上下文变化的情况下自主地处理复杂的多步程序。

blocks.en: Inference-Time Algorithms Core prompting techniques like Chain-of-Thought Wei et al. (2022) , Self-Consistency Wang et al. (2022) , and In-Context Learning Dong et al. (2024) enhance step-by-step reasoning but lack long-horizon planning capabilities. Search-based extensions such as Tree of Thoughts Yao et al. (2023) , Graph of Thoughts Besta et al. (2024) , and REBASE Wu et al. (2024) expand trajectory exploration to improve plan robustness, yet they lack structured constraint enforcement. While agentic frameworks attempt to separate planning from execution via incremental adjustments (ReAct Yao et al. (2022) , Pre-Act Rawat et al. (2025) ) or critique loops (Reflexion Shinn et al. (2023) , TextGrad Yuksekgonul et al. (2024) ), they remain vulnerable to conversational noise. GRASP builds on these paradigms by completely isolating generation, revision, and verification across decoupled context windows.
blocks.zh: 推论-时间算法 核心催化技术,如 " 思想链 " Wei等人(2022年)、 " 自我维持性 " 等 Wang et al. (2022),以及In-Context Learning Dong et al. (2024) 增强分步推理,但缺乏长视距规划能力. 基于搜索的扩展,如"思想之树"(Yao等人)(2023年),"思想之图"(Besta等人)(2024年),以及REBASE Wu等人. (2024) 扩大轨迹探索,以提高计划的稳健性,但它们缺乏结构性的制约执行. 虽然代理框架试图通过递增调整(ReAct Yao等人(2022年)、Pre-Act Rawat等人(2025年))或批判循环(Reflexion Shinn等人(2023年)、TextGrad Yuksekgonul等人(2024年))将规划与执行分开,但它们仍然容易受到对话噪音的影响。 巨猿生存方案以这些范式为基础,在已脱钩的上下文窗口之间完全隔离生成、修订和核实。

blocks.en: Automated Planning Multi-agent and constraint-guided frameworks mark recent advances in plan optimization. PlanGEN Parmar et al. (2025) combines constraint, selection, and verification agents to refine test-time search spaces. Similarly, hybrid symbolic-LLM methods like PDDL-Instruct Verma et al. (2025) demonstrate that guiding inference through structured rules and deterministic constraints dramatically optimizes plan validity Mahdavi et al. (2024) ; Wei et al. (2025) ; Cao et al. (2025) . While advanced multi-agent orchestrators like Magentic UI Mozannar et al. (2025) incorporate memory and execution guards, they rely heavily on human-in-the-loop interaction for plan validation. In contrast, GRASP operates as a fully autonomous algorithm tailored specifically for high-quality, zero-shot plan generation and structural regularization.
blocks.zh: 自动规划多机构和制约性指导框架标志着最近在优化计划方面取得的进展。 PlanGEN Parmar等人(2025年)结合了约束,选择,以及核查剂来完善测试时间搜索空间. 同样,PDDL-Instruct Verma等人(2025年)等混合符号-LLM方法也表明,通过结构化规则和确定性制约,指导性推论大大优化了计划有效性Mahdavi等人(2024年);Wei等人(2025年);Cao等人(2025年)。 虽然Magentic UI Mozannar 等人(2025年)等高级多剂管弦乐家包含了记忆和处决守卫,但他们在计划验证时严重依赖人与人的互动. 相比之下,巨猿生存方案是专门为高质量零镜头计划生成和结构规范化而专门设计的完全自主的算法。

blocks.en: 3 GRASP
blocks.zh: 3个巨猿生存方案

blocks.en: In this section, we introduce the GRASP (Generating, Revising, and Assessing for Strategic Planning) framework and explain the operational details of its constituent components. The framework decomposes the end-to-end planning problem into three specialized modules that are executed sequentially: (i) GenPlan , which generates a structural blueprint of the plan strictly based on the natural language task description 𝒯 \mathcal{T} ; (ii) RevPlan , which adapts and refines this baseline plan using a localized task instance ℐ \mathcal{I} by exploring distinct strategic paths (defined as heuristics in Polya (1945) ); and (iii) VerPlan , which acts as an independent evaluator to verify whether constraints are satisfied and selects the optimal plan 𝒫 ∗ \mathcal{P}^{*} . Each module comprises distinct computational blocks that leverage targeted prompting to keep the language model focused on the specific sub-task and operating in a reliable manner.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍巨猿生存方案(Geneting,Revising,以及评估战略规划)框架,并解释其组成部分的业务细节。 该框架将端到端的规划问题分解为三个按顺序执行的专门模块:(一) Gen Plan,它产生一个严格基于自然语言任务描述T\mathcal{T}的计划结构蓝图;(二) Rev Plan,它利用本地化任务实例I\mathcal{I},通过探索不同的战略路径(在Polya(1945年)被定义为heuristics);和(三) Ver Plan,它作为一个独立评估者,负责核实制约因素是否得到满足,并选择最佳计划P *\mathcal{P}^{*}. 每个模块都包含不同的计算块,利用有针对性的提示,使语言模型侧重于具体的次级任务,并以可靠的方式运作。

blocks.en: Architecturally, GRASP is designed to enable explicit context isolation. Standard plan generation frameworks often suffer from performance degradation because they force a model to simultaneously process global constraints, track variables, and generate local steps within the same context window. GRASP avoids this contextual overload by splitting these requirements across the three decoupled stages. We now describe each module in detail. The exact prompts, detailed configurations, and algorithmic pseudo-code for each component agent are provided in the Appendix.
blocks.zh: 在建筑上,巨猿生存方案的设计是为了实现明确的背景隔离。 标准计划制定框架往往受到业绩退化的影响,因为它们迫使一个模型同时处理全球制约因素,跟踪变量,并在同一个上下文窗口内产生本地步骤。 巨猿生存方案通过将这些要求分成三个脱钩阶段,避免了这种背景超载。 我们现在详细描述每个单元。 附录提供了每个组件代理的确切提示、详细配置和算法伪码。

blocks.en: 3.1 GenPlan
blocks.zh: 3.1 通用计划

blocks.en: The GenPlan module handles macro-level plan generation by mapping the task description 𝒯 \mathcal{T} into a structured baseline plan 𝒫 G \mathcal{P}_{G} while remaining oblivious to the task instance ℐ \mathcal{I} . 𝒫 G \mathcal{P}_{G} serves as a blueprint based on which instance-specific plans will be structured. Monolithic LLMs struggle with single-shot plan generation. They produce fluent text that fails under rigorous inspection due to missing logical primitives or implicit constraint violations. This degradation occurs because standard LLMs lack explicit mechanisms to separate task parameters from runtime variables, leading to unrecoverable cascading errors. To balance the flexibility of natural language and the strict adherence to task requirements, GenPlan decomposes planning into component steps with memory managed through the knowledge base ( 𝒦 ​ ℬ \mathcal{KB} ) and three specialized, prompt-engineered agents: the Constraint Agent (CA), the Guidelines Agent (GA) and the Plan Generation Agent (PGA).
blocks.zh: GenPlan模块通过将任务描述 T\ mathcal{T} 映射到结构化的基线计划 P G\mathcal{P}_{G} 来处理宏级计划生成, 同时仍然忽略任务实例 I\ mathcal{I}. P G\mathcal{P}_{G} 作为构建特定实例计划的蓝图. 单弹道LLMS与单弹道计划生成斗争. 它们产生流利的文本,由于缺少逻辑原始或隐含的制约性违反,在严格的检查下未能完成. 这种退化是因为标准LLMs缺乏将任务参数与运行时变量分开的明确机制,导致无法恢复的连带错误. 为了平衡自然语言的灵活性和严格遵守任务要求,GenPlan将规划分解成由知识库(K B\mathcal{KB})和三个专业的,即时设计的代理:约束代理(CA),准则代理(GA)和计划生成代理(PGA)管理的内存组成步骤.

blocks.en: Our design is conceptually grounded in formal cognitive models of human planning, specifically working memory management and self regulation. When human experts encounter dense specifications, they do not try to do detailed planning immediately. Instead, they isolate abstract environmental rules from 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , continuously reflecting and refining their mental model before applying it to concrete instances ℐ \mathcal{I} .
blocks.zh: 我们的设计概念上基于人类规划的正式认知模型,特别是工作记忆管理和自我调节. 当人类专家遇到密集的规格时,他们并不试图立即进行详细规划. 相反,它们将抽象的环境规则从T\ mathcal{T}中分离出来,不断反思和完善其精神模式,然后将其应用到具体实例 I\ mathcal{I}.

blocks.en: GenPlan formalizes this cognitive reflection loop. We define the 𝒦 ​ ℬ \mathcal{KB} as a memory store for the task, constraints, guidelines and the tentative plan. The CA, GA and PGA operate over this shared 𝒦 ​ ℬ \mathcal{KB} within an iterative feedback loop, balancing natural language flexibility with structural reliability. This continuous reflection process enables the framework to incrementally correct inconsistencies, uncover overlooked details, and converge towards a stable, accurate plan 𝒫 G \mathcal{P}_{G}

blocks.en: Knowledge Base

blocks.en: The Knowledge Base serves as the centralized state manager for the GenPlan module. Instead of maintaining floating context variables, the framework aggregates all supporting directives such as constraints and guidelines and the tentative plan into a single structured tuple. Formally, at any iterative step t t , we have, 𝒦 ​ ℬ t = ⟨ 𝒯 , 𝒞 t , 𝒢 t , 𝒫 t ⟩ \displaystyle\mathcal{KB}_{t}=\langle\mathcal{T},\mathcal{C}_{t},\mathcal{G}_{t},\mathcal{P}_{t}\rangle (1) where 𝒞 t \mathcal{C}_{t} represents the set of hard constraints, 𝒢 t \mathcal{G}_{t} represents the set of soft guidelines, and 𝒫 t \mathcal{P}_{t} represents the tentative baseline plan. The 𝒦 ​ ℬ \mathcal{KB} handles user-specifications, which include the initial guidelines and constraints. If provided, the 𝒦 ​ ℬ \mathcal{KB} is initialized as, 𝒦 ​ ℬ 0 = ⟨ 𝒯 , 𝒞 init , 𝒢 init , ∅ ⟩ \displaystyle\mathcal{KB}_{0}=\langle\mathcal{T},\mathcal{C}_{\text{init}},\mathcal{G}_{\text{init}},\emptyset\rangle (2) If no initial guidelines 𝒢 0 \mathcal{G}_{0} or constraints 𝒞 0 \mathcal{C}_{0} are provided, then they are also initialized as empty sets. The CA, GA and PGA read from the 𝒦 ​ ℬ \mathcal{KB} and perform updates to generate new entries or structurally modify existing entries.

blocks.en: Guidelines Agent (GA)
blocks.zh: 准则代理人(GA)

blocks.en: Guidelines operate as soft, non-binding regularizers or operational heuristics that are designed to optimize plan quality and coherence Gerevini et al. (2009) . The GA identifies new guidelines from the existing 𝒦 ​ ℬ \mathcal{KB} and merges them with the current guidelines. More formally, 𝒢 t + 1 = MERGE ​ ( 𝒢 t , GA ​ ( 𝒦 ​ ℬ t ) ) . \displaystyle\mathcal{G}_{t+1}=\text{MERGE}(\mathcal{G}_{t},\text{GA}(\mathcal{KB}_{t})). (3) Guidelines enforce structural consistency, uniform phrasing, and boundaries across the plan. However, even if a specific guideline in 𝒢 \mathcal{G} is violated, a candidate plan may remain logically valid. In general, enforcing guidelines minimizes generative drift, highlighting the role of guidelines as soft regularizers over the decoding space of the LLM.

blocks.en: In contrast to soft guidelines, constraints represent strict, necessary conditions that the plan must satisfy to be classified as executable and valid Gerevini et al. (2009) . (4) To ensure maximum plan reliability, GRASP allows users to manually enter constraints at initialization. However, even when GenPlan operates in a zero-shot fashion without user defined priors ( 𝒞 0 = ϕ \mathcal{C}_{0}=\phi ), the CA automatically generates a list of constraints from 𝒯 \mathcal{T} . This process ensures that the baseline plan and downstream plan synthesis follow operational boundaries. Mathematically, constraints function as hard regularizers that clip and prune logically infeasible states from the downstream plan search space.

blocks.en: 3.2 RevPlan
blocks.zh: 3.2 订正计划

blocks.en: The RevPlan module takes the macro-level baseline plan 𝒫 G \mathcal{P}_{G} generated by the GenPlan block, and specializes it for a specific task instance ℐ \mathcal{I} . In traditional software engineering, an execution instance simply supplies static data parameters to a deterministic function. In contrast, within the GRASP framework, ℐ \mathcal{I} introduces dynamic runtime directives, such as edge-case exceptions, shifting operational priorities and unmodeled environmental circumstances. To satisfy these runtime directives without violating the core structural plan rules established in GenPlan, RevPlan refines the plan 𝒫 G \mathcal{P}_{G} by systematically introducing, modifying or removing discrete execution steps based on a multi-path exploration on the strategy space.
blocks.zh: RevPlan模块采用GenPlan块生成的宏级基线计划P G\mathcal{P}_{G},并专门用于特定任务实例I\mathcal{I}. 在传统的软件工程中,一个执行实例只是将静态数据参数提供给一个决定性函数. 相比之下,在巨猿生存方案框架内,I\mathcal{I}引入了动态运行时间指令,如边缘情况例外、转移业务重点和未建模的环境环境。 为了在不违反Gen Plan中确立的核心结构计划规则的情况下满足这些运行时间指令,Rev Plan对P G\mathcal{P}_{G}计划进行了完善,在战略空间的多路径探索的基础上,系统地引入,修改或移除了独立的执行步骤.

blocks.en: To prevent the model from prematurely converging on a single suboptimal decoding path, we forego a linear revision pass. Instead, as outlined in Algorithm 2 , we expand the planning space into parallel, strategy-based tracks using two primary stages, strategy induction and strategy-specific plan merging.
blocks.zh: 为了防止模型过早在单一的次最佳解码路径上聚合,我们放弃了线性修正通过. 相反,正如算法2所概述的那样,我们利用两个初级阶段,即战略简介和具体战略计划合并,将规划空间扩大为平行的、基于战略的轨道。

blocks.en: In the strategy induction stage, we first derive a set of strategies by evaluating the task 𝒯 \mathcal{T} and the task instance ℐ \mathcal{I} . We define this strategy space as, 𝒮 = { s 1 , s 2 , … , s K } \displaystyle\mathcal{S}=\{s_{1},s_{2},\ldots,s_{K}\} (8) where K K represents the number of distinct strategies explored. In this work, we typically consider 2 ≤ K ≤ 4 2\leq K\leq 4 . This parallelization captures diverse and valid strategic paths that an LLM might otherwise discard if it is forced to commit to a single path early on.
blocks.zh: 在策略上岗阶段,我们首先通过评价任务T\ mathcal{T}和任务实例I\mathcal{I}来得出一套策略. 我们定义这个策略空间为, S = {s 1, s 2, ... , s K }\displaystyle\ mathcal{S}=\{s_{1}, s_{2},\ldots, s_{K}\}} (8) KK代表所探讨的不同战略的数目。 在这项工作中,我们通常考虑2 ≤ K ≤ 4 \ 2\ \ \ K qleq 4。 这种平行性捕捉到多种有效的战略路径,如果LLM被迫及早致力于一条单一路径,否则它可能放弃这些路径。

blocks.en: RevPlan then initiates K K contextually isolated tracks, one for each strategy. Within each track, we generate a set of localized constraints 𝒞 s k \mathcal{C}_{s_{k}} , which act as rigid guardrails for the subsequent planning phase. For each isolated track, we construct a strategy-specific plan candidate 𝒫 ( k ) \mathcal{P}^{(k)} through the following three-phase pipeline. • First, we leverage the ReAct framework Yao et al. (2022) to generate a strategy-specific solution trajectory χ s k \chi_{s_{k}} . The reason-observe-act framework in the ReAct solution interleaves reasoning traces with structural actions, while aligning with the strategy-specific constraints 𝒞 s k \mathcal{C}_{s_{k}} . This solution provides a valid path towards the goal of the pair of 𝒯 \mathcal{T} and ℐ \mathcal{I} . • We then apply an extraction function to isolate the executable steps from the verbose solution trajectory χ s k \chi_{s_{k}} , 𝒫 specific ( k ) = ExtractPlan ​ ( χ s k ) \displaystyle\mathcal{P}_{\text{specific}}^{(k)}=\text{ExtractPlan}(\chi_{s_{k}}) (9) This operation isolates the structural plan from the exact solution details, yielding an instance-focused plan without the GenPlan guardrails. • Finally, we reconcile this instance-specific plan with the structural blueprint provided by GenPlan, 𝒫 ( k ) = MergePlans ​ ( 𝒫 specific ( k ) , 𝒫 G ) . \displaystyle\mathcal{P}^{(k)}=\text{MergePlans}(\mathcal{P}_{\text{specific}}^{(k)},\mathcal{P}_{G}). (10) This plan-merge operation preserves the structural blueprint established via 𝒫 G \mathcal{P}_{G} , while integrating the strategy-specific logic of 𝒫 specific ( k ) \mathcal{P}_{\text{specific}}^{(k)} . Thus, maintaining strict contextual isolation across the K K tracks ensures that hallucinations and compounding errors in one trajectory do not harm other trajectories. blocks.en: 3.3 VerPlan
blocks.zh: 3.3 行动计划

blocks.en: VerPlan is the final module of GRASP. VerPlan functions as a decoupled plan evaluator to assess the set of candidate plans ℙ \mathbb{P} generated by RevPlan. We implement this verification stage because the individual strategy-based plans may still contain logical errors, omit crucial steps, or suffer from varying levels of infeasibility depending on the exact task and instance. To identify these shortcomings and filter out low-quality plans, VerPlan evaluates each candidate plan independently within an isolated context window.
blocks.zh: VerPlan是巨猿生存方案的最后模块. VerPlan作为一个脱钩的计划评价员,负责评估RevPlan生成的一套候选计划P\mathbb{P}. 我们实施这一核查阶段,是因为基于战略的个别计划可能仍然含有逻辑错误,省略关键步骤,或因具体任务和实例而存在不同程度的不可行性。 为了找出这些缺点并过滤出低质量计划,VerPlan在一个孤立的背景窗口中独立评价每个候选计划.

blocks.en: Each candidate plan is assessed using an LLM, which acts as the scoring function. The LLM functions as an unbiased discriminator and scorer to provide an objective assessment of feasibility and reliability.
blocks.zh: 每个候选计划都使用LLM进行评估,LLM是评分功能. LLM作为一个无偏见的歧视者和计分者,对可行性和可靠性进行客观评估。

blocks.en: For each track k k , we evaluate the candidate plan 𝒫 ( k ) \mathcal{P}^{(k)} against the task 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , instance ℐ \mathcal{I} , GenPlan constraints 𝒞 \mathcal{C} , strategy-specific constraints 𝒞 s k \mathcal{C}_{s_{k}} and internal rubrics. We prompt the LLM to output a plan quality score Ψ ( k ) ∈ [ 0,100 ] \Psi^{(k)}\in[0,100] . This score reflects the plan’s likelihood of success and its strict adherence to the constraints. More formally, Ψ ( k ) = Score ​ ( 𝒫 ( k ) | 𝒯 , ℐ , 𝒞 , 𝒞 s k , Rubrics ) \displaystyle\Psi^{(k)}=\text{Score}(\mathcal{P}^{(k)}|\mathcal{T},\mathcal{I},\mathcal{C},\mathcal{C}_{s_{k}},\text{Rubrics}) (11) This verification mechanism acts as a strict constraint-satisfaction and feasibility check, ensuring that plans that satisfy the constraints and are feasible are given higher scores. By scoring each trajectory independently, we prevent mistakes or noise due to one strategy path from biasing the evaluation of other candidates. Once the model has computed the evaluation scores for all K K candidates, we choose the plan with the highest score, 𝒫 ∗ = a ​ r ​ g ​ max 𝒫 ( k ) ∈ ℙ ​ Ψ ( k ) . \displaystyle\mathcal{P}^{*}=arg\max_{\mathcal{P}^{(k)}\in\mathbb{P}}\Psi^{(k)}. (12) The selected plan 𝒫 ∗ \mathcal{P}^{*} is chosen as the final, high-confidence output of GRASP.
4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4. 评价

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: To evaluate the quality of plan generation with GRASP, we utilize four distinct benchmarks spanning administrative logistics, hard logic matrices, and expert-level scientific reasoning: Natural Plan Calendar Scheduling Zheng et al. (2024) , GPQA Rein et al. (2024) , SciBench Math Wang et al. (2024) and ZebraLogic Lin et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 为了评价利用巨猿生存方案制定计划的质量,我们采用了四个不同的基准,包括行政后勤、硬逻辑矩阵和专家一级的科学推理: 自然计划日程安排 郑等人(2024年),GPQA Rein等人(2024年),SciBench Math Wang et al. (2024)和 ZebraLogic Lin et al. (2025) (英语).

blocks.en: The Execution Platform: RunAgent
blocks.zh: 执行平台:运行代理

blocks.en: In order to guarantee a standard, objective baseline for how plans translate into actions, all generated plans across all frameworks are systematically run through RunAgent Srivastava et al. (2026) . RunAgent functions as a multi-agent execution platform that interprets natural language steps of a plan and executes them. RunAgent utilizes frontier LLMs for executing plans. RunAgent (GPT-4o Hurst et al. (2024) ) is utilized for the Natural Plan Calendar Scheduling, Scibench Math and GPQA datasets. RunAgent (GPT-4.1-mini OpenAI (2025b) ) is utilized for the ZebraLogic dataset. Even though RunAgent includes many features such as constraint generation and verification, fact utilization, agentic language and running state summaries, we run a bare-bones version of RunAgent, where only the LLM or Python code execution are utilized for executing steps. Further, error correction is only invoked to overcome runtime errors. This ensures that poor plan quality is not compensated by verification protocols.
blocks.zh: 为了保证计划转化为行动的标准、客观基线,所有框架中产生的所有计划都通过RunAgent Srivastava等人(2026年)系统运行。 RunAgent作为多代理执行平台,负责解释计划中的自然语言步骤并进行执行. 运行代理公司利用前沿有限责任公司来执行计划。 RunAgent(GPT-4o Hurst等人(2024年))被用于自然计划日程安排,Scibench Math和GPQA数据集. RunAgent(GPT-4.1-mini OpenAI(2025b))用于斑马洛格数据集. 尽管RunAgent包含许多功能,如约束生成和验证,事实利用,代理语言和运行状态摘要,但我们运行了RunAgent的裸骨版本,执行步骤只使用LLM或Python代码执行. 此外,错误更正仅用于克服运行时间错误。 这确保了计划质量差不能通过核查议定书得到补偿。

blocks.en: Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 实验设置

blocks.en:
Our evaluation isolates GRASP’s effectiveness in planning across two distinct experiments. More details are provided in Appendix D . • Single Task Planning with Programmatic execution (Experiment 1): In this experiment, a common task is described to GRASP based on the specific dataset, and each problem is provided as an instance. Each generated plan is executed with RunAgent.
This experiment shows the utility of GRASP plans for agentic-tool-use use cases across all datasets. • Robustness for Compound Task Scaling (Experiment 2): To evaluate the resilience of GRASP under dual-task objectives, we test the planners on Natural Plan Calendar Scheduling by scaling the tasks from simple tasks with single goals to tasks with two or three objectives. We turn off the Python code execution in RunAgent for this experiment, and run each step using only LLMs.
This experiment highlights GRASP’s structural resilience under complex task loads.

blocks.en: Evaluation Metrics and Baselines

blocks.en: We report Exact Match (EM) accuracy for the Natural Plan Calendar Scheduling dataset, and standard accuracy percentages for the SciBench Math, GPQA and ZebraLogic datasets. Manual evaluation of 50 random instances per dataset classified by GPT-5 demonstrates full agreement with human judgment. For Experiment 1, we benchmark GRASP against three types of baselines: • Direct LLM execution: Single-shot problem solving by baseline LLMs. • Baseline LLM Planner: Single-shot plan generated by LLM based on task and instance with structural guardrails in the prompt, and executed with RunAgent. • State-of-the-art Methods: Advanced algorithms including PlanGEN Parmar et al. (2025) (all four variants), Tree-of-thoughts (ToT) Yao et al. (2023) and Best-of-N (BoN) Gui et al. (2024) are used to generate plans, which are then executed by RunAgent. To rigorously examine whether GRASP can outperform frontier reasoning models in plan generation for dual-task objectives, we introduce GPT-5-mini (medium reasoning effort) OpenAI (2025a) as a baseline direct planner alongside GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini for comparison in Experiment 2.

blocks.en: Robustness for Compound Task Scaling
blocks.zh: 复合任务扩展的强度

blocks.en: Performance under Multi-Task Scaling The results for multi-task scaling are summarized in Table 7 . While all planners achieve parity on isolated single tasks (hovering between 44.5 % 44.5\% and 45.8 % 45.8\% ), expanding the workspace to interleaved multi-task streams causes direct planners to collapse due to context pollution. Moving from dual to triple tasks, the direct GPT-4o planner decays from 30.5 % 30.5\% to 29.1 % 29.1\% , and the GPT-4o-mini planner drops from 24.5 % 24.5\% to 21.2 % 21.2\% . Conversely, GRASP(GPT-4o) maintains performance, achieving 45.7 % 45.7\% on dual tasks and rising to 46.6 % 46.6\% on triple tasks, outperforming its direct planner counterpart by 17.5 % 17.5\% . GRASP also enables smaller LLMs to excel on dual tasks, driving GRASP(GPT-4o-mini) to 41.2 % 41.2\% (a 16.7 % 16.7\% absolute gain over its direct baseline).
blocks.zh: 多任务扩展下的绩效 表7汇总了多任务规模调整的结果。 虽然所有规划者都在孤立的单一任务上实现了均等(覆盖范围在44.5%至45.8%之间),但扩大工作空间,将多任务流隔开,导致直接规划者因环境污染而崩溃。 从双重任务转向三重任务,直接的GPT-4o规划器衰减率从30.5%-30.5%%下降到29.1% 29.1%,而GPT-4o-mini规划器则从24.5%-24.5%下降到21.2%21.2%。 反之,巨猿生存方案(GPT-4o)保持业绩,在双重任务方面达到45.7%,在三重任务方面达到46.6%,在直接规划人员对应人员方面达到17.5%的优势。 巨猿生存方案还使小型有限责任公司能够出色完成双重任务,将巨猿生存方案(GPT-4o-mini)推向41.2%的41.2%(比直接基线的16.7%的绝对收益)。

blocks.en: Comparison Against Reasoning Models We evaluate direct planners driven by GPT-5-mini, a frontier reasoning model. Despite this optimization, the direct GPT-5-mini planner succumbs to multi-task context degradation, scoring only 26.7 % 26.7\% on dual tasks and dropping to 25.5 % 25.5\% on triple tasks. Both GRASP configurations comprehensively outperform this frontier reasoning model. Crucially, GRASP(GPT-4o-mini) achieves 41.2 % 41.2\% on dual tasks, outperforming the direct GPT-5-mini planner by a 14.5 % 14.5\% absolute margin.
blocks.zh: 与合理模式的比较 我们评价由GPT-5-mini驱动的直接规划者,一种前沿推理模型. 尽管如此优化,直接的GPT-5-mini规划师还是屈从于多任务背景的退化,在双重任务上只得26.7%的分数,在三重任务上则降至25.5%的25.5%的分数. 巨猿生存方案的两个配置都全面超过了这一前沿推理模型。 关键是,GRASP(GPT-4o-mini)在双重任务上实现了41.2%的41.2\%,比直接的GPT-5-mini规划者的表现高出14.5%的14.5\%绝对比值.

blocks.en: Ablation Studies We execute an ablation study under the dual-task setup, summarized in Table 8 . Isolating single modules shows that GenPlan Only yields 40.8 % 40.8\% accuracy, proving the vital anchoring role of guidelines and constraints. In contrast, activating local strategy exploration without structural boundaries (RevPlan Only or RevPlan + VerPlan) causes a catastrophic drop to 10.9 % 10.9\% and 12.5 % 12.5\% , respectively—performing substantially worse than VerPlan Only ( 30.7 % 30.7\% ). The highest overall performance is unlocked strictly when all modules interact in the full GRASP architecture ( 45.7 % 45.7\% ).
blocks.zh: 阅读研究 在双重任务安排下,我们进行了一项减征研究,摘要见表8。 孤立的单一模块显示,GenPlan只产生40.8%的准确度,证明了准则和制约因素的重要锚点作用。 相比之下,启动没有结构性界限的本地战略探索(RevPlan Only或RevPlan + VerPlan)导致灾难性下降,分别下降到10.9%、10.9 % 和 12.5%、12.5 % , 表现大大低于VerPlan Only(30.7%、30.7 % ) 。 当所有模块在全巨猿生存方案架构中相互作用时,最高的整体性能被严格解锁(45.7%)。

blocks.en: Discussion The ablation study reveals a profound modular interdependence. VerPlan Only acts as a passive filter over standard direct generations, yielding baseline levels. However, executing local updates (RevPlan) without the invariant structural guardrails of GenPlan triggers unconstrained semantic drift and plan hallucinations. This creates a set of low quality plans, catching the downstream VerPlan module in a classic "garbage-in, garbage-out" trap that drops performance to 12.5 % 12.5\% . This confirms that local strategy optimization requires global regularization. Additionally, our triple-task results uncover a clear capacity boundary condition for smaller models. While GRASP(GPT-4o-mini) performs robustly on dual tasks ( 41.2 % 41.2\% ), it collapses to 28.1 % 28.1\% on triple tasks. This demonstrates that under extreme multi-task workloads, smaller LLMs lack the raw parameter capacity to successfully manage complex instructions without suffering local attention drift, establishing a hardware-bound capability threshold.
blocks.zh: 讨论情况 该研究揭示了一种深刻的模块相互依存关系。 计划 只充当对标准直接代数的被动过滤器,产生基线水平. 然而,在没有GenPlan变化无常的结构护栏的情况下执行本地更新(RevPlan),触发了不受约束的语义漂移和计划幻觉. 这创造了一套低质量的计划,将下游的VerPlan模块夹在经典的"垃圾箱,垃圾箱"陷阱中,将性能降低到12.5 % 12.5.%. 这证实,优化地方战略需要全球规范化。 此外,我们的三重任务成果为较小的模型明确了能力界限条件。 GRASP(GPT-4o-mini)在双重任务(41.2% 41.2\%)上表现强劲,但在三重任务上则崩溃到28.1% 28.1% 。 这表明,在极端的多任务工作量下,较小的有限责任公司缺乏原始参数能力,无法成功管理复杂的指令,而不受当地注意力漂移的影响,从而建立了硬件约束的能力门槛。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduced GRASP, an autonomous framework that neutralizes context degradation and plan hallucinations in complex tasks. By decoupling plan generation, strategy exploration, and validation across context-isolated agents, our architecture successfully eliminates compounding error cascades. Our evaluations prove that explicit structural guardrails enable standard LLMs to systematically outperform the unguided internal reasoning chains of frontier reasoning models.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了巨猿生存方案,这是一个自主的框架,它能够消除环境退化,并在复杂的任务中规划幻觉。 通过将计划生成,战略探索, 和各种上下文隔离剂的验证脱钩, 我们的建筑成功地消除了复合错误级联。 我们的评估证明,明确的结构护卫使标准有限责任公司能够系统地超越边界推理模型中无指导的内部推理链。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Latency Considerations While our framework prioritizes execution reliability, the iterative generation, local refinement, and systematic verification of multiple alternative strategies inherently incurs higher runtime latency compared to single-pass, monolithic generation. We consider this additional computational overhead a necessary trade-off to ensure structural robustness and eliminate compounding error loops in highly complex tasks. However, this latency characteristic may limit the framework’s suitability for real-time, interactive applications where immediate response times are critical, defining a clear trajectory for future work to explore parallelized generation pipelines or early-exit optimization heuristics to reduce inference time.
blocks.zh: 延迟考虑 虽然我们的框架优先考虑执行的可靠性,但迭代生成、局部改进和系统核查多种替代战略必然会比单路、单路生成的运行时间长。 我们认为,这种额外的计算间接费用是一种必要的权衡,以确保结构稳健,消除高度复杂任务的复杂误差循环。 然而,这种暂时性特征可能会限制框架在即时反应时间至关重要的实时交互式应用程序的适宜性,为今后探索平行发电管道或提前退出优化推论以减少推论时间的工作确定明确的轨道。

blocks.en: Orthogonal to Model-Level Reasoning A fundamental characteristic of GRASP is that it operates strictly as an inference-time plan regularizer rather than a mechanism for improving the intrinsic, low-level reasoning capabilities of the underlying language model. If a backbone possesses severe baseline domain ignorance or lacks the foundational logic to understand a given task space, our framework cannot bridge that cognitive deficit. GRASP is explicitly designed to optimize plan execution safety by decoupling context and enforcing macro-constraints, allowing models to fully express their latent capabilities without attention fatigue. It does not train or structurally alter the underlying model’s multi-stage internal reasoning chains. This limitation is specifically highlighted in our experiments. We observe that GRASP does not outperform the direct planner on the GPQA dataset, the SciBench Diff and the SciBench Calc datasets. Problems in all three datasets rely not just on building a good plan, but on improving the reasoning capability of the underlying LLM itself.
blocks.zh: 正对模型级 巨猿生存方案的一个基本特点是它严格地作为推论时间计划调节器运作,而不是作为提高基础语言模型内在的低级推理能力的机制. 如果一个骨干拥有严重的基线域无知或缺乏理解特定任务空间的基础逻辑,我们的框架无法弥补这种认知缺陷。 GRASP被明确设计为通过脱钩上下文和执行宏观约束来优化计划执行安全,使模型能够充分表达其潜伏能力而无需关注疲劳. 它不会训练或从结构上改变基本模型的多阶段内部推理链。 我们的实验中特别强调了这一局限性。 我们观测到,巨猿生存方案在GPQA数据集,Sci Bench Diff和Sci Bench Calc数据集上没有超过直接规划员的表现. 所有三个数据集的问题不仅依赖于制定好计划,还依赖于提高基础LLM本身的推理能力.

blocks.en: Task-Dependent Strategy Tuning A key limitation of the current framework is that the optimal number of generated strategy-based plans behaves as a task-dependent hyperparameter rather than a fixed, universal value. For instance, in our Calendar Scheduling evaluations, system performance peaks sharply at a sweet spot of three candidate strategies; while fewer strategies limit the explored search space, generating more introduces excessive diversity that can mislead the VerPlan discriminator toward sub-optimal choices. Consequently, deploying GRASP across highly heterogeneous domains currently requires manual tuning to balance strategic exploration with downstream execution reliability, highlighting a valuable avenue for automated, dynamically adjusting number of strategies in future iterations.
blocks.zh: 任务依赖战略 现行框架的一个关键限制是,生成的战略计划的最佳数量表现为依赖任务的超参数,而不是固定的普遍价值。 例如,在我们的日程安排评价中,系统业绩在三个候选战略的甜点上急剧达到顶峰;虽然较少的战略限制探索的搜索空间,但产生更多的多样性,会误导VerPlan歧视者作出次优选择。 因此,在高度不同的领域部署巨猿生存方案,目前需要人工调整,以平衡战略勘探和下游执行可靠性,强调在今后迭代中自动、动态调整战略数量的宝贵途径。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: The use of GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini and GPT-5-mini throughout this work adheres to the OpenAI developer terms, data governance guidelines and safety usage policies.
blocks.zh: 在整个工作中使用GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini和GPT-5-mini遵循OpenAI开发者术语、数据治理准则和安全使用政策。

blocks.en: GRASP increases the structural reliability, logical consistency and execution fidelity of complex multi-step plans, and could be potentially adapted by malicious actors to optimize harmful plans. We note that GRASP functions strictly as a plan optimization framework, and lacks physical agency, real-world permissions, or independent tool-use capabilities. We strongly advocate for the enforcement of strict verification guardrails and human-in-the-loop validation protocols in any production environments that deploy planners such as GRASP.
blocks.zh: 巨猿生存方案提高了复杂多步骤计划的结构可靠性、逻辑一致性和执行的忠实性,并有可能被恶意行为者加以调整,以优化有害计划。 我们注意到,巨猿生存方案严格地作为计划优化框架,缺乏实体代理、现实世界权限或独立的工具使用能力。 我们强烈主张在部署巨猿生存方案等规划人员的任何生产环境中,执行严格的核查护栏和人与人之间的验证协议。

blocks.en: GRASP fundamentally relies on the internal semantic representations and latent knowledge space of its underlying base LLM. While it enforces structural correctness, constraint verification, and soft guideline regularization, it doesn’t natively correct or filter out embedded historical, cultural, or demographic biases hidden in the base model’s weights. If user-provided parameters or instructions introduce biased or problematic premises, running GRASP may produce plans that are structurally sound and optimized, but are ethically compromised or socially harmful.
blocks.zh: 巨猿生存方案从根本上依赖其基础LLM的内部语义表述和潜在知识空间。 虽然它执行结构正确性、约束性核查和软准则规范化,但它并没有在本土上纠正或过滤隐藏在基准模型权重中的嵌入式历史、文化或人口偏见。 如果用户提供的参数或指示引入有偏见或有问题的前提,运行巨猿生存方案可能会产生结构合理和优化的计划,但会在道德上受损或对社会有害。

blocks.en: Our work utilizes standard and publicly available benchmarks, but executes real-world planning tasks such as calendar scheduling involves handling highly sensitive user data. Multi-agent pipelines risk context-bleed or unauthorized data persistence. Care should be taken to prevent sensitive parameters from leaking into public training loops.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作利用标准基准和公开基准,但执行诸如日历排期等现实世界的规划任务涉及处理高度敏感的用户数据。 多剂输油管存在因环境原因导致或未经批准的数据持久性的风险。 应注意防止敏感参数渗入公共培训循环。

blocks.en: Iterative multi-agent frameworks lead to compounding computational costs and environmental footprints, if not engineered with care. Poorly optimized multi-agent setups regularly trap LLMs in verbose, unconstrained self-reflection loops that use huge number of tokens, incurring substantial environmental costs for negligible accuracy returns. GRASP mitigates this environmental concern through its design. As shown in Sec. 4.2 , GRASP provides performance gains while limiting token costs. Moreover GRASP’s token usage is highly competitive when compared to other baselines, as shown in Table 9 . This results in a reasonable overhead for the environmental impact and computational costs of GRASP for the performance gains provided.
blocks.zh: 迭代多剂框架导致计算成本和环境足迹的复合,如果不是精心设计的话。 优化不良的多剂设置经常将LLMs夹在动词中,不受约束的自我反射循环使用大量符号,为可忽略不计的精确度回报而引起巨大的环境成本. 巨猿生存方案通过设计减轻了这一环境问题。 如第4.2节所示,巨猿生存方案提供性能收益,同时限制象征性费用。 此外,如表9所示,巨猿生存方案与其他基线相比,其象征性用途具有很高的竞争力。 这导致巨猿生存方案环境影响的合理间接费用和提供的业绩收益的计算费用。

blocks.zh: 附录A 今后的工作

blocks.en: We plan to extend our plan-generation framework by incorporating a human-in-the-loop component. In the current design, human input can be injected alongside the task and instance specification—for example, by supplying additional guidelines, facts, or constraints beyond those automatically inferred by our algorithm. In practice, however, task specifications may contain ambiguous or incomplete information. To address this, we plan to introduce an interactive chat interface that automatically formulates clarification queries to the user. While generating questions about missing or unclear information is relatively straightforward, using the same interface to solicit high-level guidance for plan construction (e.g., decomposition strategies or expert heuristics) is significantly more challenging.
blocks.zh: 我们计划扩大我们的计划制定框架,纳入一个“即时”部分。 在目前的设计中,人的投入可以与任务和实例规格一起注入,例如,提供超出我们算法自动推断的额外准则、事实或制约。 但实际上,任务规格可能包含模糊或不完整的信息。 为了解决这个问题,我们计划引入一个交互式聊天界面,自动向用户提出澄清询问。 虽然产生关于缺失或不明信息的问题相对来说是直接的,但使用同一接口为计划建设寻求高级别指导(如分解战略或专家休眠)则具有更大的挑战性。

blocks.en: A second extension involves enabling runtime plan modification by examining the output of each step and adjusting the plan dynamically. This includes verifying the correctness and relevance of intermediate results and re-executing steps when necessary by feeding verification feedback back into the LLM. In more complex cases, the system may need to insert new steps or revise existing ones to ensure proper plan execution. The evaluation of step-level outputs can leverage task-specific rubrics, and the interactive chat window also allows the system to request such rubrics from the human when dealing with critical stages of the plan.
blocks.zh: 第二次延期涉及通过审查每一步骤的产出和动态调整计划,使运行时间计划得以修改。 这包括核查中间结果的正确性和相关性,并在必要时通过将核查反馈反馈反馈给LLM而重新实施步骤。 在更复杂的情况下,系统可能需要插入新的步骤或修改现有的步骤,以确保妥善执行计划。 对步级输出的评价可以发挥特定任务标题的杠杆作用,交互聊天窗口也允许系统在处理计划的关键阶段时向人请求这种标题.

blocks.en: Standard calendar-scheduling instances require finding one feasible meeting time. Dual and triple tasks extend this into composite objectives: the model must solve the original scheduling problem and one or two auxiliary consultant-calendar subproblems, returning a strictly formatted multi-line answer. A dual task has two sub-objectives, with output on exactly two newline-separated lines (no extra text). This prompt is given in Table 11 . A triple task adds a third sub-objective (three newline-separated lines must be output). This prompt is given in Table 12 .
blocks.zh: 标准日历排定情况需要找到一个可行的会议时间。 双重和三重任务将它扩展到复合目标:模型必须解决原来的调度问题和一两个辅助顾问-日历子问题,返回一个严格格式化的多行答案. 一个双重任务有两个子目标,输出在完全两条新线分隔的行上(没有额外的文本). 表11列出了这个提示。 三重任务增加了第三个子目标(三条新线分隔线必须是输出). 表12列出了这个提示。

blocks.en: Each instance is composed of two parts. The first part contains the original instance of the Natural Plan Calendar Scheduling zero-shot prompt, and the second part contains the schedule of Consultant D, shown in Table 13 , or the schedules of both Consultant D and Consultant E (shown in Table 14 ). In a similar way, the first part of the gold answers corresponds to the gold answer of the associated calendar scheduling instance, and the second part of the gold answer corresponds to the fixed answer for the latest free slot of Consultant D’s schedule for the dual task, or the latest free slot in both Consultant D and Consultant E’s schedule, for the triple task instruction.
blocks.zh: 每个案例由两部分组成。 第一部分是自然计划日程安排0射速率的最初实例,第二部分是表13所示顾问D的时间表,或顾问D和顾问E的时间表(见表14)。 同样,黄金答案的第一部分对应相关日历排程实例的黄金答案,黄金答案的第二部分对应顾问D的双任务排程的最新自由档位的固定答案,或者顾问D和顾问E的双任务排程中的最新自由档位,三任务指令.

blocks.en: The first task measures performance on standard calendar scheduling instances. Therefore, this part of the prompt varies per instance. The second part of the prompt is fixed for every instance, and measures whether the agent can parse dense calendars, apply working-hour bounds, identify 30-minute gaps, and select the latest slot, not merely a free slot. The intent of the second part of the prompt is not to be a challenging problem. The auxiliary tasks are designed to be very simple, so that the individual LLMs can solve them easily. However, when the auxiliary tasks are combined with calendar scheduling tasks, the plan accuracy goes down.
blocks.zh: 第一个任务衡量标准日历排程实例的绩效。 因此,这一部分的及时性因实例而异。 提示的第二部分是针对每个实例的固定的,并测量代理机是否能够解析稠密的日历,应用工作时间界限,识别30分钟的间隔,并选择最新的槽,而不仅仅是一个自由的槽. 迅速行动第二部分的意图并不是要成为一个具有挑战性的问题。 辅助任务的设计非常简单,这样单个的LLMS就可以轻松地解决. 然而,当辅助任务与日历排程任务相结合时,计划准确性会下降.

blocks.en: Below, we describe the exact setup of each method in the ablation study in Table 8 . • Direct Planner : A plan is directly generated using the prompt provided in Appendix I for Experiment 2. This new prompt ensures low plan leakage by GPT-5-mini. • GenPlan Only : A plan is generated using the GenPlan module, and run for all instances. • RevPlan Only : Four strategy-based plans are generated, and one of them is randomly chosen and executed. • VerPlan Only : Four plans are generated using the Direct Planner prompt, and VerPlan chooses the best one by scoring each plan. The plan with the highest score is executed. • GenPlan+RevPlan : First a plan is generated by GenPlan based on the task, then four plans are generated by RevPlan based on strategies, and normalized by GenPlan’s output. Then a plan is randomly chosen for execution. • RevPlan+VerPlan : Four strategy-based plans are generated by RevPlan, and then scored by VerPlan. The best plan is chosen for execution. • GRASP : The full framework is used to generate a good plan.

blocks.en: Appendix E Statistical Analysis, Plan Efficiency and Information Leakage

blocks.en: E.1 Statistical Analysis
blocks.zh: E.1 统计分析

blocks.en: Experiment 1
blocks.zh: 实验1

blocks.en: We first note that if GRASP outperforms its closest competitor in a statistically significant way, then it also statistically outperforms all other competitors. Therefore, we only look at the closest performers in this section.
blocks.zh: 我们首先指出,如果巨猿生存方案以具有统计意义的方式超越其最密切的竞争者,那么在统计上也超越所有其他竞争者。 因此,我们只关注本节中最接近的表演者。

blocks.en: We compare GRASP with PlanGEN(BoN) in this case. We use the McNemar test to determine that the p-value is < 0.0001 <0.0001 . Therefore, GRASP outperforms every baseline with high confidence from the statistical perspective.
blocks.zh: 在此情况下,我们将巨猿生存方案与PlanGEN(BON)进行比较。 我们用麦克尼马尔测试来确定p值 < 0.0001 < 0.0001。 因此,从统计角度看,巨猿生存方案的业绩高于每一基线,具有很高的信心。

blocks.en: We compare against PlanGEN(BoN) in this case as well. Even though GRASP outperforms PlanGEN(BoN) by 2 % 2\% , by applying the McNemar test, we find that the result is not statistically significant with a p-value of 0.33 0.33 . However, GRASP outperforms all other baselines in a statistically significant fashion, with a p-value < 0.01 <0.01 .
blocks.zh: 我们与PlanGEN(BON)在此案中进行比较。 尽管巨猿生存方案(BON)通过应用McNemar测试,比PlanGEN(BON)高了2%,但我们发现结果在统计学上并不重要,p值为0.330.33。 然而,巨猿生存方案以具有统计意义的方式超过了所有其他基线,p值 < 0.01 < 0.01。

blocks.en: Since each SciBench Math subset is a very small dataset, achieving statistical significance requires a significant increase in accuracy. However, due to the difficulty of the dataset, even a relatively modest increase is highly valuable. Therefore, we provide the bootstrapped 95 % 95\% confidence intervals for this dataset. For the SciBench Stat dataset, the confidence intervals are [ 75 % , 91.67 % ] [75\%,91.67\%] for GRASP and [ 68.06 % , 87.5 % ] [68.06\%,87.5\%] for the other two methods. The p-value is 0.3438 0.3438 in this case. For SciBench Calc and Diff, the PlanGEN baselines perform at the same level as GRASP, so we do not perform a statistical analysis for them.
blocks.zh: 从每个SciBench开始 数学子集是一个非常小的数据集,实现统计意义需要大大提高精度. 然而,由于数据集的难度,即使相对适度的增加也是非常有价值的. 因此,我们为这个数据集提供了95%95%的置信间隔。 对于SciBench Stat数据集,置信间隔为:巨猿生存方案[75%,91.67%][75\%,91.67\%],其他两种方法[68.06%,87.5%][68.06\%,87.5\%]. 本案的p值为0.34380.3438. 对SciBench Calc和Diff来说,PlanGEN基线的运行水平与巨猿生存方案相同,因此我们不对它们进行统计分析.

blocks.en: We compare GRASP against the direct planner in this case, and find that the p-value is 0.6793 0.6793 , which clarifies that GRASP does not outperform the direct gpt-4o planner in a statistically significant way.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了巨猿生存方案与本案的直接规划者,发现p值为0.6793 0.6793,这说明巨猿生存方案在统计学上没有以超过直接gpt-4o规划者的方式完成.

blocks.en: Experiment 2
blocks.zh: 实验2

blocks.en: First, we observe that GRASP(GPT-4o) outperforms all other baselines with a p-value of < 0.01 <0.01 under the McNemar test. For the ablation study in Table 8 , GRASP also outperforms all other models with a p-value of < 0.01 <0.01 when averaged over three runs.
blocks.zh: 首先,我们发现,在麦克尼马尔试验中,巨猿生存方案(GPT-4o)的绩效超过了所有其他基线,p值 < 0.01 < 0.01。 就表8中的扩展研究而言,巨猿生存方案在P值小于0.01 < 0.01的所有其他模型的平均运行时间也超过所有其他模型。

blocks.en: E.2 Plan Efficiency for Experiment 1
blocks.zh: E.2 实验计划的效率 1

blocks.en: The average plan length is 12.67 steps for GRASP and 9.74 steps for PlanGEN(BoN). This shows that the plans generated by GRASP are much longer. This tells us that GRASP autonomously generates longer plans for challenging problems, and the accuracy increases by a large margin as a result.
blocks.zh: 平均计划长度为巨猿生存方案12.67步,PlanGEN(BON)9.74步。 这表明巨猿生存方案产生的计划要长得多。 这告诉我们,巨猿生存方案自主地为具有挑战性的问题提出了更长的计划,因此准确性提高了很大幅度。

blocks.en: We find that the plans for GRASP average 11.3 steps, whereas for PlanGEN(BoN) they average 13.09 steps.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,巨猿生存计划的平均步骤为11.3级,而PlanGEN(BON)的平均步骤为13.09级。

blocks.en: For the SciBench Stat dataset, we find that the plans generated by GRASP average 9.18 steps, the plans for BoN average 6.96 steps and the plans for PlanGEN(Rebase) average 9.53 steps. For the SciBench Diff dataset, we find that the plans generated by GRASP average 11.66 steps and the plans generated by PlanGEN(Mix) average 14.2 steps. For the SciBench Calc dataset, we find that the plans generated by GRASP average 11.39 steps, and the plans generated by PlanGEN(Mix) average 14.85 steps.
blocks.zh: 关于SciBench Stat数据集,我们发现,巨猿生存方案产生的计划平均为9.18级,BON计划平均为6.96级,PlanGEN(Rebase)计划平均为9.53级。 对于SciBench Diff数据集,我们发现巨猿生存方案生成的计划平均为11.66步,PlanGEN(Mix)生成的计划平均为14.2步. 对于SciBench Calc数据集,我们发现巨猿生存方案生成的计划平均为11.39步,而PlanGEN(Mix)生成的计划平均为14.85步.

blocks.en: E.3 Information Leakage in Experiment 1
blocks.zh: E.3 实验1中的信息泄漏

blocks.en: We say that there is information leakage in a plan if the final answer for the task-instance pair appears anywhere in the plan.
blocks.zh: 我们说,如果任务组合的最后答案出现在计划中的任何地方,计划就会产生信息泄漏。

blocks.en: We find that 31 plans with information leakage were generated by GRASP, whereas PlanGEN(BoN) generated 145 such plans. Therefore, if we calculate the accuracy while considering plans that violate the constraint that the final answer of the task instance pair should not be given as an output, then the accuracy of GRASP(gpt-4o-mini) remains 55.7 % 55.7\% , whereas the accuracy of PlanGEN(BoN) falls to 27.1 % 27.1\% . This shows that enforcing constraints significantly reduces the accuracy in the baseline methods, but GRASP shows very little plan information leakage, and follows constraints in a strict fashion.
blocks.zh: 我们发现巨猿生存方案产生了31项信息泄漏计划,而PlanGEN(BON)则产生了145项此类计划。 因此,如果我们在计算准确性的同时考虑那些违反任务实例组合的最终答案不应作为输出的限制因素的计划,那么巨猿生存方案(gpt-4o-mini)的准确性仍为55.7%,而PlanGEN(BON)的准确性则降至27.1% 27.1%。 这表明执行方面的限制大大降低了基准方法的准确性,但巨猿生存方案显示的计划信息泄漏很少,并且严格遵循限制。

blocks.en: We find that no plan generated by GRASP had information leakage, whereas 103 103 plans generated by PlanGEN(BoN) had information leakage. Therefore, the accuracy of GRASP remains 74.3 % 74.3\% , whereas the accuracy of PlanGEN(BoN) drops to 62 % 62\% . This shows that when constraints are strictly enforced, GRASP outperforms all other methods by a significant margin.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,巨猿生存方案产生的任何计划都没有信息泄漏,而PlanGEN(BON)产生的103个计划则有信息泄漏。 因此,巨猿生存方案的准确度仍为74.3%,而PlanGEN(BoN)的准确度降至62%,即62。 这表明,在严格执行限制措施时,巨猿生存方案的业绩大大超过所有其他方法。

blocks.en: For the SciBench Stat dataset, we find that there is one plan where information leakage happens in both GRASP and PlanGEN(Rebase), but no leakage happens in BoN. This leads to a revised accuracy of 80.56 % 80.56\% for GRASP, 77.78 % 77.78\% for BoN and 76.39 % 76.39\% for PlanGEN(Rebase). For the SciBench Diff dataset, we find that both GRASP and PlanGEN(Mix) have four plans where leakage happens. This leads to a revised accuracy of 42 % 42\% for both GRASP and PlanGEN(Mix). For the SciBench Calc dataset, we find that there are two plans where information leakage happens in GRASP, and seven plans where information leakage happens in PlanGEN(Mix). This leads to a revised accuracy of 68.27 % 68.27\% for GRASP, and 56.07 % 56.07\% for PlanGEN(Mix).
blocks.zh: 对于SciBench Stat数据集,我们发现,有一个计划,信息泄漏发生在GRASP和PlanGEN(Rebase)中,但是在BON没有发生泄漏. 这导致巨猿生存方案订正精度为80.56%、BON为77.78%、PlanGEN(重建基地)为76.39%。 对于SciBench Diff数据集,我们发现GRASP和PlanGEN(Mix)都有四个发生渗漏的计划. 这导致巨猿生存方案(GRASP)和PlanGEN(Mix)的准确度修订为42%。 对于SciBench Calc数据集,我们发现在GRASP中存在信息泄漏的两个计划,在PlanGEN(Mix)中存在信息泄漏的七个计划. 这导致巨猿生存方案订正精度为68.27%68.27%,PlanGEN(混合)订正精度为56.07%56.07%。

blocks.en: E.4 Discussion
blocks.zh: E.4 讨论情况

blocks.en: When we look at the statistical analysis of the results from Section 4.2 , we see that some results are not statistically significant. However, upon closer inspection, we see that GRASP consistently generates shorter plans which yield higher accuracy, while consuming less tokens than state-of-the-art baselines. Moreover, when a simple constraint is strictly enforced, we see that GRASP maintains a similar accuracy, whereas the accuracies of baselines drop by more than 10 % 10\% . This shows that GRASP achieves higher accuracy, generates shorter plans (which leads to downstream savings in token consumption as well), consumes less tokens, while maintaining constraints and accuracy under multi-task instructions.
blocks.zh: 当我们审视第4.2节结果的统计分析时,我们看到一些结果在统计学上并不重要。 然而,经过更仔细的检查,我们看到巨猿生存方案不断产生更短的计划,其准确度更高,同时消耗的象征物比最先进的基线要少。 此外,当一个简单的限制被严格执行时,我们看到巨猿生存方案保持类似的准确性,而基线的精度下降了10%以上。 这表明巨猿生存方案实现了更高的准确性,产生了更短的计划(这也导致象征性消费的下游节省),消耗的代币较少,同时在多任务指令下保持了约束和准确性.
